name: Cone Occlusion based on Gaussian Integrals
definition: A volume rendering shading technique that approximates light occlusion and shadowing using cone tracing with Gaussian integrals. It supports two modes: Cone Occlusion (for self-shadowing/occlusion) and Cone Shadow (for external light source shadows).
summary: Cone Occlusion based on Gaussian Integrals approximates light occlusion in voxel volumes by tracing cones and integrating extinction coefficients using Gaussian distributions.
